description.value: Gather is a neighbourhood restaurant occupying a glass-encased corner of Kelowna's Innovation Centre, serving a distinctive fusion of modern Korean and Italian cuisine crafted by Chef Sung Ji Park, whose background spans traditional Korean home cooking and a decade in fine Italian kitchens. The intimate interior was designed and built in Italy by co-owner Luigi Coccaro, with an open kitchen that lets diners watch the cooking unfold. The menu is built around shareable small, medium, and large plates — a format rooted in both Korean and Italian dining culture — paired with a wine list of over 180 curated selections.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM name, address (105-460 Doyle Ave), and phone number. The restaurant is a modern Korean-Italian fusion concept at Kelowna's Innovation Centre, opened September 2018, with an active catering and events programme. No mention of bike parking, racks, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null; OSM diet tags (vegan=yes, vegetarian=yes) cannot be confirmed from the website text and are left null per the rules.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists info@gatherkelowna.com but the website consistently shows gather@coccarogroup.com as the contact address. The OSM email may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible sit-down restaurant in central Kelowna with an active website and confirmed contact details.
